tested_surface.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Files asset_create_folders
schema_observations: The create call accepts folder name(s) and an optional parent id; it exposes no caller-controlled idempotency key, request token, deterministic caller-selected asset identity, If-Match/version precondition, or create-if-absent flag.
The schema explicitly states that if a folder with the same name already exists, a numbered suffix is automatically added, for example MyFolder then MyFolder (1).
The output returns a server-assigned folder assetId and a name that may differ from the requested name because of collision renaming.
Because same-name replay is specified to create a renamed sibling rather than collapse onto the prior create, folder name cannot serve as an exactly-once identity under acknowledgement loss.
tested_surface.reason: For this exact surface, acknowledgement loss followed by retry can create a distinct renamed folder, and the exposed schema provides no caller-controlled idempotency or conditional-create primitive that proves the retry collapses onto the original effect.
tested_surface.scope_limit: Connector-schema-only result for asset_create_folders. No claim is made about undocumented Adobe server behavior or other Adobe write surfaces. No folder, asset, board, document, image, PDF, or external effect was created or mutated.
